title: 6.13 In the City
unit_outcome: Name places and transport, explain a current destination, complete a trip, follow directions, ask for help, choose a service and check its times.
goal: Name a city, a town, a road, a market, a building and a map, and say I drive a car. and They visit the museum.
grammar_function: It is a + place; I drive a car.; They visit + the + place.
prerequisite: 2.4 It is a + noun; 1.9 car; 6.4 museum.
speaking_outcome: Say It is a city., I drive a car. and They visit the museum.
